After receiving no response, I decided to visit the dealership personally. Only then was I informed that the required part was not available and would take about a week to arrive. Even now, I am not receiving proper updates or responses. As a customer, I should not have to repeatedly visit the dealership just to get basic information about a spare part.

This is not a professional way to handle customers. If you are unable to provide support or respond to inquiries, please do not publish contact details online that customers rely on for assistance.

I hope this issue is taken seriously and that customer service is improved in the future.

featured_reviews.name: sudhir Bansode
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently got my Mercedes-Benz serviced at Galaxy Auto Works , and the overall experience was excellent. I was especially impressed with the windshield cleaning The car feels great to drive now, and the service performance has been excellent
The team at Galaxy Auto was extremely helpful in guiding me about the right service package according to the car’s running kilometers. I truly appreciated their honest suggestions and precise guidance. They only recommended the services that were genuinely required, without pushing any unnecessary or expensive work.
A special thanks to Pinky Sundrani Ma’am and the Master technician for being so cooperative, soft-spoken, and professional throughout the process. Every employee I interacted with gave a very genuine and trustworthy feeling while discussing the car, parts, and service requirements.
Very impressed with the overall experience and highly satisfied with the service quality provided by Galaxy Auto. Thank you very much to the entire team.

featured_reviews.name: Farid Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent Service & Expert Craftsmanship

I recently had my Range Rover Sport's suspension serviced at your garage, and I couldn't be more impressed with the results. The team diagnosed the issue quickly, explained the work clearly, and completed the repairs on schedule.

Your technicians clearly know their craft, and the professionalism throughout the entire process was outstanding. The pricing was fair.

I've already recommended your garage to fellow Range Rover owners. This is exactly the kind of service that keeps me coming back. Highly recommended!

Would definitely use your services again. Five stars, without hesitation. ✅

featured_reviews.name: Burhan Contractor
featured_reviews.review_text: They repainted my car after another garage had messed up the job, and I couldn't be happier. The quality of the paintwork is excellent, smooth finish, perfect color match, and very professional results. Their customer service and communication were on point throughout the whole process: timely updates, clear explanations, and courteous staff. Great value and trustworthy workmanship. Would 100% recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Vikrant Kumbhar
featured_reviews.review_text: Galaxy Auto Works stands out for its refined approach to luxury car service. The workshop maintains high standards, and the team understands the level of care required for premium and performance vehicles. Their workmanship, communication, and commitment to customer satisfaction make them a reliable choice for luxury car owners.

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Mall
featured_reviews.review_text: It was a set of great experiences as my car has been to galaxy auto works multiple a time. They are very refined with their work, the authenticity of the hardware & parts used by the team. Best workshop in the whole city i feel. From deliveries on time to easy checkins. I can’t stop Being a loyal customer

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Gorivale
featured_reviews.review_text: Galaxy Auto Works offers dependable and professional automotive solutions for supercars and luxury vehicles. Their experienced technicians, organized workflow, and customer-focused service create a seamless experience. The center is well suited for clients seeking quality maintenance, accurate diagnostics, and trustworthy repair work.

featured_reviews.name: Shivam Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text: Really great place with a well-maintained and professional workshop. The technicians provide premium-quality maintenance and service, and the advisors are very helpful and attentive. The entire staff is cooperative, polite, and ensures a smooth customer experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking to experience premium and luxury care for their car. Do visit once for top-notch automobile service.
